procedure:
Action; native120 feet; V/S/F; native rank9/base26RP through each actual Necromancy class route. Choose one perceived living creature in range and line of effect. NEW automatic admission, no initial or ending save and no concentration. Preserve exactly10d6 necrotic over five rounds. NEW distribute as five separately resolved2d6 packets: the first at manifestation, then at the same fixed source-relative offset6,12,18 and24 elapsed seconds later. This record's explicit five-round prohibition interval ends30 seconds after manifestation, before any coincident event; it has no sixth packet. This replaces the insufficient Core Instantaneous continuation, while leaving the original card intact.

NEW cannot-heal means ordinary healing of living normal HP is prohibited while this application is operative. It does not bar temporary HP, eligible loss prevention, independently specified nonhealing direct recovery, or the returned HP assigned by a genuine resurrection. A failed healing attempt keeps its paid costs, source history and appropriate consumed entitlements; it restores0HP. Doom supplies no new damage to a missed/suppressed packet and no new healing modifier to other sources.

NEW each paid, successful source application has its own five-packet schedule and damage entitlement, including different casters. Damage applications may coexist; their healing prohibition is a nonstacking Boolean union. Recasting neither resets another application nor doubles that application's dice; there is no silently imported P20 shared-family cap. Each application has one source/Null creation-root identity, and every pulse is its distinct packet descendant. The accepted damage-sharing root means one original-recipient packet, so each pulse has its own sharingRootId and permits at most one split/transfer across all owners; the source/Null lineage is not a second sharing entitlement. Creation-time dealer/Null flag persists through later Null changes; per-packet defenses, sharing, tempHP, true floors, Wounds, life and concentration consequences still resolve separately. No packet replays after immunity, mitigation or a floor.

Actual target death ends that target's Doom applications immediately; later revival does not restore them. Caster death alone does not end these nonconcentration applications. A current-body form change preserves target identity, one HP ledger, clocks and source; its actual body/defenses govern each packet. Actual local suppression makes both that application's healing prohibition and any due pulse unavailable, but consumes that pulse at its original scheduled time. It does not suppress an independent remote application merely by reaching the caster. Resumption restores only still-live expression, with no burst, refund or extension. A lawful source-qualified removal ends all future packets and this application's prohibition. Real initiative changes, extra Actions, genuine extra turns, mode changes and save/load cannot move this explicit clock. A positive genuine-extra-turn trace remains held until an authorized acquired source and legal schedule exist; this return supplies no such grant.

Return217 director disposition: the external genuine-full-extra-turn positive witness remains conditional, and its old case stays held. This is not a whole-spell gate: the explicit source-relative schedule is fully selected and demonstrated independently of actor regular slots. No extra-turn feature is granted, no extra Action or Future Echo reorder is relabeled, and no other cohort decision is reopened.

sharedRules.death: KEEP the Core/Healing/Body/Lifecycle interfaces. Direct death is a life-state transition, with no damage packet, Wound/concentration save, HP-damage trigger or damage-immunity test. Do not manufacture numeric damage to implement it. Normal HP is retained as a ledger unless an exact state assignment changes it; actual death can coexist with positive recorded HP. Ordinary Death Ward is a positive-to-zero floor and does not prevent direct death. Actually acquired Ritual of Undeath Death Ward mode can intercept an eligible would-die event if body and all its real source gates pass. True would-die protections resolve before committing death; a successful protection is not death. Actual death ends concentration and invalidates temporary-HP holding, drops actually held equipment, closes actual temporary forms by their exact interface and preserves unique identity, wound/injury/debt/corruption/resource histories. Hunted Death and pending Soul Bind conversion follow committed death; no spell here supplies an exceptional Hunt return.

sharedRules.ready: Use the accepted Ready contract unchanged: Action at preparation, actual spell paid/cast/components/cadence/counter window once; one held spell requiring concentration until release/expiry; expiration before next regular own-start refresh. Choose targets/area at a legal Reaction release and recheck prerequisites. Illegal/declined releases do not spend a Reaction and may wait until expiry. Casting menus/save-load/mode changes grant no turn, release, death save, reaction or clock reset.
